name: XLA_LEDGER_OPTIONS_
description: This table contains the subledger accounting options.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: Transaction account definition short name.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DEFINITION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether it is a seeded transaction account definition.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: TRANSFER_TO_GL_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the general ledger journal entry summarization option

columns.name: ACCT_REVERSAL_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether accounting reversal should reverse the sides or reverse the amount signs.  The possible values are SIDE: reverse the sides for the reversal entries, SIGN: reverse the amount signs for the reversal lines.

columns.name: CAPTURE_EVENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether this is a valuation method ledger for the application

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether subledger accounting (or general ledger  consolidation) should populate the ledger.

columns.name: ENABLE_SUBMIT_POSTING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether GL Posting is allowed when accounting is created for subledger transactions.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates how amount will be rounded when rounding is performed. Possible Values are: Up: The amount will be rounded up, Down: The amount will be rounded down to nearest: The amount will be rounded to the nearest number.

columns.name: MERGE_ACCT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Third party merge accounting option.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the last entity.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period when a transaction, such as an asset retirement, is effective.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information for this application and ledger, which, when combined with the journal or balance period, determines the database partition in which journals or balances for this application and ledger are stored.

columns.name: CALC_SR_BALANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to maintain supporting reference balance for the subledger and ledger.
